notes.title: Game release!
notes.content: [h1]🎉 [b][u]The game is out![/u][/b] 🎉[/h1][p][/p][h3]Today marks the release of my game! Thank you to everyone who showed interest, waited patiently, or simply visited the store page — your support means a lot to me.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]If you decide to purchase the game — I sincerely thank you. It truly means more than words can express 🙏[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Please note that the current trailer on the Steam page is outdated. A new version that reflects the final state of the game will be uploaded in the future.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]I'm open to feedback: I will take note of any issues, fix shortcomings, and continue to improve the game if necessary.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Thank you for stopping by. This is just the beginning![/h3]
